breakdown.definition: An unplanned stop in which the car cannot be driven safely. It is the stop, not the specific fault that caused it.
breakdown.example: I have had a breakdown on the motorway, and I need a recovery vehicle.

cs_status_maintenance.definition: The work a person does to keep their place and their standing in a group.
cs_status_maintenance.example: Status maintenance is why she read the report twice before she sent it.

dual_self_control.definition: Holding a decision back for a short time so that the second argument can be made.
dual_self_control.example: A little self-control before the reply is cheaper than a retraction later.

gre_role_conflict.definition: The strain that appears when one person is expected to be two things at once and the two pull in different directions.
gre_role_conflict.example: The role conflict was not a failure of effort; two jobs had been given to one week.

human_in_the_loop.definition: A design in which a person reviews and approves an agent's work before it takes effect.

mon_minor_unit.definition: The smaller part of a currency, such as the cent of a dollar, that people rarely see.
mon_minor_unit.example: The price is 12.50 dollars, but the money is made of dollars and cents.

spec_handover.definition: The passing of work from one person to another.
spec_handover.example: At the handover she asked what the customer had actually agreed to.
